Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, someone who can balance the demands to support business growth versus the need for rigorous control? Do you have an appetite to understand the front-to-back flow to come up with creative ways to solve problems and improve processes?

We’re looking for someone who can:
• Manage under stress to deliver the best-in-class trade support across major APAC markets on Delta 1 products such as Equity Swaps, SBL and Prime Brokerage
• Work alongside support teams in China/India to ensure Front Office expectations are being met, quick turnaround to requests to meet tight market cut-offs
• Understand the F2B operational risks and apply this knowledge to ensure the integrity of our trade details in our systems
• Perform front-to-back controls to ensure position and trades are properly reconciled
• Engage with internal partners (Trading, PB Account Managers, Settlements & Confirmation, Finance, etc) to provide operational support
• Proactively identify and address control gaps
• Participate in process enhancements initiatives and new business roll-out, and the associated testing on system changes

Do you have a keen interest in working in a legal department? Do you have a background or desire to learn more about preparing, drafting, reviewing and negotiating simple contracts such as engagement letters or non-disclosure agreements? We are looking for someone to:

• Review and negotiate or assist with the negotiation of engagement letters and non-disclosure agreements in English and Chinese
• Prepare, review and assist with documentation relating to equity capital markets transactions, such as IPO ancillary documents, placing agreements, investor representation letters, disclaimers and case studies
• Prepare, review and assist with documentation relating to MTN (Medium Term Note) programmes or other securitized products
• Review Chinese versions of legal documentation
• Participate in internal special projects

Are you a target driven individual with strong ability to orchestrate complex, multi-disciplinary engagements across business divisions, leveraging expertise from various functions to develop innovative, executable, and bespoke solutions that address sophisticated client needs while balancing commercial, risk, regulatory, and operational considerations? We're looking for someone like that to:

• Lead cross-functional collaboration across Global Markets and Global Wealth Management to originate and deliver bespoke, commercially viable solutions that address complex client requirements.
• Act as the central coordinator for complex opportunities, aligning diverse stakeholders, managing competing priorities, and driving consensus to deliver timely and effective client outcomes.
• Demonstrate strong end-to-end ownership of business opportunities by mobilizing relevant functions, overcoming organizational barriers, and ensuring seamless execution of tailored solutions.
• Provide tailored investment solutions and advisory services based on our Chief Investment Officer (CIO) House View and/or market opportunities to our clients
• Provides internal education, marketing, after-sales of structured solutions
• Stay current with market trends, news, economic developments and client flows to identify actionable opportunities as well as potential risks
• Translate complex market developments into clear and compelling investment solutions and recommendations, prepare and deliver clear, concise and compelling pitch.
• Identify sales opportunities, coordinate efforts and monitor progress
• Drive business offering initiatives by optimizing processes, increasing operational efficiency, and collaborating across bank to improve client service and overall experiences

A CRB Quant Trader is responsible for developing quantitative models and managing the systematic execution of trades and orders on a principal basis.
The role focuses on generating revenue, providing liquidity to clients, and supporting client needs through disciplined risk and capital management.

Key Responsibilities:
• Generate revenue through development and timely/accurate execution and booking of trades/orders on a principal basis (generating P&L)
• Proactively keep abreast of market developments and trading opportunities; have a strong understanding of financial markets, instruments, and strategies
• Facilitate client order flow by providing liquidity via proprietary inventory (utilizing the firm’s capital) or accessing third party external offerings

• Adhere to all applicable regulations and internal policies including but not limited to quality of execution (example: best execution), trading activities (example: Volcker), pricing, hedging, trading-limits and compliance policies
• Manage broad range of risks, including but not limited to trading risk, execution risk, operational risk, compliance risk and conduct risk etc., evaluating options and making decisions
• Follow, adhere to and promote the UBS principles and behaviours acting with integrity, due skill, care, and diligence always
• Ensure escalation and disclosure of any information of which applicable regulators would reasonably expect notice
• Observe proper standards of market conduct while paying due regard to interests of customers and treating them fairly
• Where supervising other members of staff, ensure adherence to applicable regulations and internal policies via effective supervision and oversight with reference to the Principles of Good Supervision

Key Deliverables:
• Revenue generation (trading P&L, commissions, sales credits) and growing client business by provision of liquidity
• Strong contributions towards development of regional/global models driving the CRB business
• Adherence to regulations, compliance policies, desk policies, and guidelines as applicable to each market
• Risk management
• Conduct in accordance with UBS principles and behaviours along with regulatory expectations including escalation and disclosure of relevant issues

Are you at your best when solving problems for clients and building long-term relationships? Do you have a proven track record in client advising and selling? We are looking for someone who can help us:
• establish long-term mutually beneficial relationships with clients
• deliver KPIs as agreed with the respective business line in Hong Kong
• maximize client assets and revenues under UBS management
• select advisory processes and agreements designed to meet our clients’ needs, objectives and expectations
• keep accurate, up-to-date client investor profiles
• develop a client investment strategy and keep a close eye on portfolio quality
• create and implement a strategic client book development plan with measurable actions
• comply with all regulation, policies and standards, contributing to an effective risk culture
